import builtins
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, NoReturn

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` to standard output.

    Console output only: this function must not open, create, or write
    any file, and must not write to a log file.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "started")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] started\n"


def test_level_is_not_modified(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("debug", "Mixed Case Message")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[debug] Mixed Case Message\n"


def test_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("WARN", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[WARN] \n"


def test_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "hello")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] hello\n"


def test_message_with_brackets_and_unicode(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "bad [value] — café")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR] bad [value] — café\n"


def test_nothing_on_stderr(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "only stdout")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.err == ""
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] only stdout\n"


def test_multiple_calls_each_on_own_line(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "one")
    log_line("ERROR", "two")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] one\n[ERROR] two\n"


def test_does_not_touch_file_system(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    def forbidden_open(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> NoReturn:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not open files")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden_open)

    log_line("INFO", "no files please")

    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] no files please\n"
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
